description: Common collator and templated dispatch: exclusive event batches except Parquet plus Python delivery.

methodology.timed: Simulation, encoding, optional Arrow delivery/row-count consumption, event publication/fsync, database commit/close/fsync.
methodology.rss: Process peak sampled before verification; includes preparation.
methodology.load: Normal desktop background load, warm OS cache, fresh process and output for each case. Builds interleaved and case order rotated.
methodology.python_consumer: Iterate Arrow RecordBatches and count rows; retain only the current batch.
methodology.verification: Compare all 22 physical-order column SHA-256 hashes, counters, event counts, ordering, continuous event indices, codecs and row-group limits.

preliminary_sweep.reason_stopped: Interrupted to address the GCC variant-move warning, then restarted all comparisons after the ownership-holder fix. These observations measure the earlier revision and are reported separately.
